```{r class_df}
class_df <- pull_classes(sample_dir)
class_df <- class_df %>%
  mutate(Genus = sapply(str_split(class_df$V11, " "), '[[', 1)) %>%
  relocate(Genus, .after = V10)
class_df <- class_df %>%
  rename(Gram = V10, Species = V11, Subtype = V12, Sample = V13)


## class_df$sample_name <- class_df[cbind(1:nrow(class_df), max.col(!is.na(class_df), ties.method = 'last'))]

```

```{r peak alignment binning}
if (peak_alignment_method == "binning") {
  features <- mode_binning(spectra_list = spec, background_file = background_file)
  # features <- features %>% ## These lines for when filtering more peaks out
  #   filter(!between(mean_mz, 500, 700))
  feature_mean_or_mode <- "mean"
  aligned_spectra <- bin_spectra(spectra_list = spec, features, type = feature_mean_or_mode, class_df = class_df)
  filtered_mz <- switch(feature_mean_or_mode,
                        mean = features$mean_mz,
                        mode = features$mode_mz)
}
```

```{r peak alignment feature list}
if (peak_alignment_method == "featurelist") {

  feature_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(feature_file, sheet = "Sheet1", skip = 1)
  #features <- unlist(read_excel(feature_file, col_names = TRUE)[,1])
  features <- feature_df %>%
    filter(annotation_method == "MS2") %>%
    pull(mz) %>%
    as.numeric()

  ## subset features between mass range
  features <- features[features >= mass_range[1] & features <= mass_range[2]]

  matched_spec <-  target_mz_alignment(spectra_list = spec, target_mz = features, ppm = ppm_error, handle_dups = "sum")

  aligned_spectra <- bind_rows(matched_spec, .id = "sample_name") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = target_mz, values_from = intensity, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

  filtered_mz <- features
}
```

```{r normalization}
xall <- as.matrix(normalize_pixel(aligned_spectra, normalization_method))
if (cube_root) xall <- xall^(1/3)
```

## Create data for training

## Train/Test Split

``` {r split}
metadata <- read.csv("Data/sample_names_df.csv")

class_df$patient <- metadata$patient[match(class_df$Sample, metadata$sample_name)]

test_count <- round(table(class_df$Species)*(1-train_fraction),0)

test_index <- vector()
for (c in unique(class_df$Species)){
  set.seed(seed)
  test_index <- c(test_index, sample(which(class_df$Species == c & is.na(class_df$patient)), 
                                     size = test_count[c]))
}

train_index <- (1:nrow(metadata))[-test_index]

class_df$train_test_set <- ifelse(rownames(class_df) %in% train_index, "train", "test")

## test on isolates of matched specimens 1046, 1275, 1277, 1359, 1063
class_df$train_test_set[which(class_df$patient %in% c(1046, 1275, 1277, 1359, 1063))] <- "test"

otr <- which(class_df$train_test_set == "train")
metadata$train_test_set <- ifelse(metadata$X %in% otr, "train", "test")
yall <- factor(class_df$Gram)
classes <- levels(yall)

otr <- class_df$train_test_set == "train" ## Rename to match for xgboost
```

## Patient Matched Train/Test Splits for foldid in XGBoost

```{r set foldid}
## Unique patients in training set
train_df <- class_df[otr,]
train_patients <- unique(train_df$patient[!is.na(train_df$patient)])

if (nfolds == "LOOCV") {
  nfolds <- length(train_patients)
  nfolds_display <- "LOOCV"          # <-- save before overwriting
} else {
  nfolds_display <- nfolds
}

## Randomly assign each patient to a fold
set.seed(seed)
patient_fold_map <- data.frame(
  patient = sample(train_patients),
  fold = rep(1:nfolds, length.out = length(train_patients))
)

foldid <- patient_fold_map$fold[match(train_df$patient, patient_fold_map$patient)]

## Randomly assign fold to samples with no patient ID
no_patient <- which(is.na(foldid))
set.seed(seed)
foldid[no_patient] <- sample(rep(1:nfolds, length.out = length(no_patient)))

folds_list <- lapply(1:nfolds, function(i) {
  which(foldid == i)
})
```

```{r Split Data into Training and Testing Sets}
## create training set
xtrain <- xall[otr, ]
ytrain <- yall[otr]

## create testing set
xtest <- xall[!otr, ]
ytest <- yall[!otr]

## xgboost dense matrix with labels
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(xtrain),
  label = as.numeric(ytrain) - 1
)
```

```{r mlr3mbo bayesian hyperparameter optimization for XGBoost, include = FALSE}
## Launch workers
plan(sequential)

fun <- function(xdt) {
  results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(xdt)), function(i) {
    dtrain_worker <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data  = as.matrix(xtrain),
      label = as.numeric(ytrain) - 1
    )
    param <- list(
      base_score        = 0.5,
      tree_method       = "hist",
      device            = "cpu",
      eta               = exp(xdt$eta[i]),
      max_depth         = as.integer(xdt$max_depth[i]),
      min_child_weight  = as.integer(xdt$min_child_weight[i]),
      subsample         = xdt$subsample[i],
      lambda            = exp(xdt$lambda[i]),
      alpha             = xdt$alpha[i],
      gamma             = xdt$gamma[i],
      colsample_bytree  = xdt$colsample_bytree[i],
      nthread           = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
      booster           = "gbtree",
      objective         = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric       = "auc"
    )
    set.seed(seed)
    xgbcv <- xgb.cv(
      params                = param,
      data                  = dtrain_worker,
      nround                = 200,
      folds                 = folds_list,
      prediction            = TRUE,
      early_stopping_rounds = 15,
      verbose               = 0,
      maximize              = TRUE
    )
    best_auc <- max(xgbcv$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)
    if (best_auc <= 0.5) best_auc <- 0.501
    data.table(auc = best_auc)
  })
  rbindlist(results)
}

## Search space
domain <- ps(
  eta              = p_dbl(lower = log(0.005), upper = log(0.3)),  ## log scale bounds
  max_depth        = p_int(lower = 2L,  upper = 8L),
  min_child_weight = p_int(lower = 1L,  upper = 10L),
  subsample        = p_dbl(lower = 0.6, upper = 1.0),
  lambda           = p_dbl(lower = log(0.1), upper = log(20)),     ## log scale bounds
  alpha            = p_dbl(lower = 0,   upper = 5),
  gamma            = p_dbl(lower = 0,   upper = 5),
  colsample_bytree = p_dbl(lower = 0.3, upper = 1.0)
)
codomain <- ps(auc = p_dbl(tags = "maximize"))

## ObjectiveRFunDt wraps fun() for use with bbotk/mlr3mbo.
objective <- ObjectiveRFunDt$new(
  fun      = fun,
  domain   = domain,
  codomain = codomain
)

instance <- oi(
  objective  = objective,
  terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 250)
)

## 80 Sobol points = 10 x d for d = 8
design <- generate_design_sobol(instance$search_space, n = 80)$data
instance$eval_batch(design)

## Gaussian process with Matérn 5/2 kernel — the recommended surrogate for purely numeric search spaces (Becker et al., 2026)
surrogate <- srlrn(
  lrn("regr.km", covtype = "matern5_2",
      optim.method = "BFGS", control = list(trace = FALSE)),
  archive      = instance$archive,
  input_trafo  = InputTrafoUnitcube$new(),
  output_trafo = OutputTrafoStandardize$new()
)

## Expected Improvement (EI) acquisition + Local Search Optimization (handles mixed integer/continuous space)
acq_function  <- acqf("ei")
acq_optimizer <- acqo(
  opt("local_search"),
  terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 5000L),
  warmstart = TRUE,
  warmstart_size = 10L
)

## bayesopt_ego: sequential Efficient Global Optimization — one evaluation per iteration, fully guided by the GP surrogate.
optimizer <- opt("mbo",
  loop_function = bayesopt_ego,
  surrogate     = surrogate,
  acq_function  = acq_function,
  acq_optimizer = acq_optimizer,
  args          = list(random_interleave_iter = 10L)
)

set.seed(seed)
optimizer$optimize(instance)
```

``` {r final model}
## mlr3mbo was much quicker than other packages for Bayesion hyperparameter selection
## Pre-print link: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.29730
## Extract best parameters from mlr3mbo instance
best <- instance$result_x_domain  ## named list of best params

final_params <- list(
  objective        = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric      = "auc",
  booster          = "gbtree",
  tree_method      = "hist",
  device           = "cpu",
  eta              = exp(best$eta),
  max_depth        = as.integer(best$max_depth),
  min_child_weight = as.integer(best$min_child_weight),
  subsample        = best$subsample,
  lambda           = exp(best$lambda),
  alpha            = best$alpha,
  gamma            = best$gamma,
  colsample_bytree = best$colsample_bytree
)

## Re-run xgb.cv with best hyperparameters to recover OOF predictions and best_nrounds
set.seed(seed)
xgbcv_best <- xgb.cv(
  params = final_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 200,
  folds = folds_list,
  prediction = TRUE,
  early_stopping_rounds = 15,
  verbose = 0,
  maximize = TRUE
)
best_nrounds <- which.max(xgbcv_best$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)

## Final model trained on full training set
set.seed(seed)
final_model <- xgb.train(
  params = final_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  verbose = 1
)
```

``` {r roc metrics}
cv_predictions <- as.numeric(xgbcv_best$cv_predict$pred)

roc_curve <- roc(ytrain, cv_predictions)

roc_df <- data.frame(
  cutoff      = roc_curve$thresholds,
  sensitivity = roc_curve$sensitivities,
  specificity = roc_curve$specificities)

roc_df$accuracy <- (roc_df$sensitivity * length(roc_curve$cases) +
                    roc_df$specificity * length(roc_curve$controls)) /
                   (length(roc_curve$cases) + length(roc_curve$controls))

roc_metrics <- ggplot(roc_df) +
  geom_line(aes(cutoff, sensitivity, col = "Sensitivity")) +
  geom_line(aes(cutoff, specificity, col = "Specificity")) +
  geom_line(aes(cutoff, accuracy,    col = "Accuracy")) +
  labs(x = "cutoff", y = "%", color = "") +
  ggtitle("Trade off of performance metrics for determining threshold cutoff value")
```

``` {r best threshold}
best_threshold <- as.double(coords(roc_curve, "best",
                                   ret = "threshold",
                                   best.method = "youden")[1, 1])
```

``` {r feature importance 2}
coef2 <- data.frame(
  Features = importance$Feature,
  Gain     = format(round(as.numeric(importance$Gain), 4), nsmall = 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(coef2) <- c("Features", "Importance (Gain)")

## XGBoost gain has no direction, so split into two ranked columns for layout
half         <- ceiling(nrow(coef2) / 2)
left_feats   <- coef2[seq_len(half), ]
right_feats  <- coef2[seq(half + 1, nrow(coef2)), ]

max_len      <- max(nrow(left_feats), nrow(right_feats))
length_pad   <- function(df, n) df[seq_len(n), ]   # pads with NA rows
left_feats   <- length_pad(left_feats,  max_len)
right_feats  <- length_pad(right_feats, max_len)

split_coefs  <- cbind(left_feats, right_feats)
split_coefs[is.na(split_coefs)] <- ""

colnames(split_coefs) <- c("Features (m/z)", "Importance (Gain)",
                            "Features (m/z)", "Importance (Gain)")

## ── Feature importance table kable ──────────────────────────────────────────
split_coefs %>%
  kable(row.names = FALSE,
        align     = "c",
        linesep   = "") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1:2, width = "1.5in") %>%
  column_spec(3:4, width = "1.5in")
```

```{r feature bar plot}
coef3 <- coef2 %>%
  mutate(mz   = as.numeric(Features),
         gain = as.numeric(.data[["Importance (Gain)"]]))

max_y <- max(coef3$gain, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

coef_plot <- ggplot(coef3,
                    aes(x = mz, y = gain)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 2, fill = cols[2]) +
  labs(y = "Importance (Gain)", x = expression(italic("m/z"))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = mass_range, ylim = c(0, max_y)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(mass_range[1], mass_range[2], by = 50),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  ggtitle("Model Feature Importance by Gain") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

coef_plot
```

``` {r histogram plots}
train_plot <- ggplot(train_df, aes(x = probability, fill = true_class, color = true_class)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, alpha = 0.25, position = "identity", boundary = 0) +
  ggtitle("Model Prediction Probabilities: Training Set") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_threshold, linewidth = 0.75, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), minor_breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), expand = c(0.05, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cols, labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  labs(x = "Prediction Probability", y = "Spectra Count", color = "True Class", fill = "True Class") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

test_plot <- ggplot(test_df, aes(x = probability, fill = true_class, color = true_class)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, alpha = 0.25, position = "identity", boundary = 0) +
  ggtitle("Model Prediction Probabilities: Test Set") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_threshold, linewidth = 0.75, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), minor_breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), expand = c(0.05, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cols, labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  labs(x = "Prediction Probability", y = "Spectra Count", color = "True Class", fill = "True Class") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
